meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先检查项目里的知识图谱文件。它在图谱里搜索与问题相关的节点和关联，再基于这些信息回答代码库的问题，并指出涉及的文件、函数和层次。若图谱不存在，会提示先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当你就当前代码库提问，或想借助项目的知识图谱理解代码的结构与依赖时触发。

say.text: 这个项目主要用什么语言和框架开发？
say.note: 它会读取项目元数据来回答。

say.text: 结算模块依赖哪些服务或数据表？
say.note: 它会按图谱里的依赖边梳理上下游。

say.text: processOrder 这个函数被谁调用？
say.note: 它会沿调用关系找出上游调用方。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude checks for a project knowledge-graph file and searches it for relevant nodes and edges, then answers codebase questions, citing files, functions and layers. If absent, it tells the user to run /understand first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about the current codebase or want to use the project's knowledge graph to understand code structure and dependencies.

say_en.text: What languages and frameworks does this project mainly use?
say_en.note: Claude reads the project metadata to answer.

say_en.text: Which services or data tables does the settlement module depend on?
say_en.note: It follows dependency edges in the graph.
It resolves upstream callers along call relationships.
